title: doftiles
description: Personal dotfiles: GNU Stow packages, Makefile deployment with hooks, herbstluftwm on WSL2.

content.heading: doftiles
content: dots - herbstluftwm on WSL2, deployed with GNU Stow and Make.
[https://github.com/akinevz2/doftiles](https://github.com/akinevz2/doftiles)

content.heading: From the README
content: Every top-level directory is a stow package whose contents mirror `$HOME`; recipes link them with `stow -R -t $HOME <package>`. Deploy through make, never bare stow.

```sh
cd ~/dots
git submodule update --init --recursive
WSL2 needs VcXsrv on the Windows side
use `DISPLAY=localhost:0.0`.

content.heading: Packages provided
content: 14 stow packages:

content.heading: Shell and tooling
content: shell - `.bashrcx`, `.profile`, aliases, exports; firefox -> Windows Firefox; `check-wsl`
git - `~/.my-credentials`, `load-credentials` hook, `dekineify`, home `~/Makefile`
llms - OpenCode + poolside config, SonarQube/MCP tooling
task - Taskwarrior config
vim - Vim config
zshell - Oh My Zsh config

content.heading: Window manager stack
content: herbst - autostart, keybinds, ~40 scripts (`hc_*`, `rofi_*`, `polyctl`, `winbarctl`)
polybar - `config.ini`, `polywins` (submodule), [polyframes](/projects/polyframes) (the renderer binary, now its own project), `ewmh_labels`
compton - compositor config, rofi context-menu helpers
rofi - themes, applets, ~40 `bin/` helpers
dunst - notification config, mail scripts
alacritty - terminal config

content.heading: Services and maintenance
content: services - systemd units: `herbst`, `compton`, `dunst` (+ disabled `xvfb`/`x11vnc`/`novnc`)
maintenance - `check-msi-dirs` oneshot (dunst alert)
Caveat: `wm.packages` is stale - pre-rename `opencode`, omits `vim`/`zshell`/`maintenance`; stow those individually.

content.heading: The polyframes renderer
content: The bar's window-list renderer is a standalone native binary: [polyframes](/projects/polyframes) — a bunli/Bun TypeScript CLI compiled with `bun build --compile` (its own repo; the dots tree carries none of it).

It renders the center module (one label per frame+class group, state-decorated, click/scroll actions) and hosts the helpers that used to live here: the rofi menus (`tags`, `hidden`, `windows`, `launch`), `hc_tile`/`hc_center`/`hc_resize` equivalents, `hc_fit_to`-style constraint passes, one-shot `rule once` spawns, and `hc_unmaximize`'s janitor daemon trigger.

Why a binary: polybar's spawn environment has no nvm PATH — the compiled executable embeds its runtime and re-executes ITSELF in the bar's click-action strings, so no shim and no node setup is needed.

`hc_center`/`hc_resize` remain here as two-line exec-shims delegating to the binary (dots-side callers keep their names). All WM reads go through [herbstutil](https://github.com/akinevz2/herbstutil) (typed JSON). Install: `make install` in the polyframes repo; bar wiring: `[module/polyframes]` in `config.ini`.

content.heading: Float registers: mod-f / mod-x / mod-ctrl-f
content: The float registers are hlwm configuration wired to the [polyframes](/projects/polyframes) binary. The state machines live in `herbst/.local/bin` (`hc_focus`, `hc_floatx`, `hc_zoom`).

mod-f toggles the WINDOW's floating state: tiled to float (size preserved, decoration-aware center, fit pass, focus follows) and back. A single-float policy: when a visible float exists, the press focuses the floating layer instead of stacking a second float.

mod-x toggles the LAYER focus: float focused hands focus to the tiling layer (the float stays); tiling focus + visible float slurps the float into the frame (via hc_tile when the frame is populated and non-max); tiling focus + no floats yanks the focused window out (float + center in the monitor), and closes the vacated frame when the yanked window was its only client.

mod-ctrl-f zooms: the fresh float is stretched to the frame with its decoration outline flush to the frame's content rect (content = frame minus the theme's floating margins), then a fit pass keeps the full outline on-screen.

Geometry writes reconcile against hlwm's real content rect afterwards: float size hints can snap sizes, and the placement re-runs once from the read-back truth - verified against decoration_geometry reads, not the values we wrote.
